[EN] [Solo] Need a Rest
[ES] [Solo] Necesito un descanso
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Meren in Highwatch.
[ES] Ve con Meren a Highwatch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the Teleport Scroll to go to Launa. [Press key to open inventory and use a Bleakrock Teleport Scroll to teleport to Launa's location.]
[ES] Usa el pergamino de teletransporte para ir con Launa. [Presiona la tecla para abrir el inventario y usa un pergamino de teletransporte de Bleakrock para teletransportarte a la ubicación de Launa.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Give Launa a hand by claiming 4 Guardian Legion Mission rewards.
[ES] Échale una mano a Launa reclamando 4 recompensas de misiones de la Legión de Guardianes.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to Bleakrock and speak with Launa.
[ES] Regresa a Bleakrock y habla con Launa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the Frost Stone to empower the Eternal Crown. [Press key to open inventory and use a Frost Stone.]
[ES] Usa la piedra de escarcha para potenciar la Corona eterna. [Presiona la tecla para abrir el inventario y usar una piedra de escarcha.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I should get going."
[ES] «Debería ponerme en marcha».
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Launa again.
[ES] Habla con Launa de nuevo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to help."
[ES] "Un placer ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Meren in Highwatch.
[ES] Habla con Meren en Highwatch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
